annotations.text:
Poster-bento concept for bellaworksweb.com
Inspired by the supplied reference: rounded color-block tiles on a dark ground, chunky condensed display type, a script accent, round stamp + speech bubble, icon strip.
Brand mapping: reference red → Bellaworks blue #3689b4 and navy #223e60, cream tiles, orange #db6e35 for the script + CTA.
Copy is lifted verbatim from the current homepage.
